attributes.name: Tukanem-Hanam
attributes.powers:
Tukanem-Hanam is immune to the Electricity, Mental, and Poison traits.

Before you act, succeed at a Wisdom or Perception 7 check or you are dealt 1 Electricity damage.

If the check to defeat has the Fire trait, add 1d6.

If undefeated, each character at this location is dealt 1d4 Electricity damage.
